rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a fine sharpening stone used on blades.

example.english: This hone is used to sharpen a razor's edge.
example.traditional: 呢嚿油石係用嚟磨利剃刀刀鋒嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gau6 jau4 sek6 hai6 jung6 lei4 mo4 lei6 tai3 dou1 dou1 fung1 ge3

rows.note: Use this technical machine-tool term specifically for a precision boring machine.

example.english: The machinist uses a hone to machine this precision bore.
example.traditional: 師傅用鏜床加工呢個精密孔。
example.jyutping: si1 fu6 jung6 tong1 cong4 gaa1 gung1 ni1 go3 zing1 mat6 hung2
